# GitHub Copilot Instructions - Francis Family Cloud

## Project Purpose

**Project Name**: Francis Family Cloud
**Framework**: Next.js
**Description**: A private family file box with admin-managed roster login, S3-backed storage, controlled share links, and copy-in imports from major cloud providers.

This file is a project wrapper. Read [AI_POLICY.md](../AI_POLICY.md) first; it is the canonical repo-wide AI policy for all assistants.
